title: 第7章 购买赐福神箓＼神恩如海第8章 个人任务贰平山神符
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“武道修为提升？”
“没想到这位村长的武道之心这么强。”
“可惜武道资质不佳，和李有鸣相差仿佛。”
“三十五岁了也只完成两次气血蜕变，达到一阶中位就再无寸进。”
“为人也还算得上公正，小错犯过，大错没有。”
“小善做过，大善没有。”
“既然如此虔诚的信仰……”
“便满足你的祈愿……”
李越面色平静。
他手中有两张一阶‘赐福神箓’。
一阶‘赐福神箓’可以让毫无修为的信士从凡人晋升成为一阶‘炼体境’武者。
而且晋升后直接就是两次气血蜕变，成为一阶中位的‘炼体境’武者。
这是其中一个作用。
而一阶‘赐福神箓’还有另一个作用。
可以让本就是一阶炼体境的武者，修为提升两个小境界，但却无法跨越大境界。
也就是说——
原本一阶下位，可以直接提升到一阶上位！
原本一阶中位，可以提升到一阶极限！
但哪怕原本是一阶上位，也依旧只能提升到一阶极限！
“至于另一张一阶‘赐福神箓’……”

他目光扫过‘乙级信士’的名单。
此时‘乙级信士’已经增加到了二十七名！
不过其中大部分都是老人以及中年人。
年轻人只有两位。
一位是二十二岁的李修武。
一位是二十五岁的李德明。
“李德明是李有鸣的次子。”
“一家人不可恩荣过甚。”
“这一张一阶‘赐福神箓’就赐予李修武吧。”
他自语道。
至于将一阶‘赐福神箓’放在「神只店铺」卖出去，他丝毫没有这种想法。
一阶的物品，哪怕‘赐福神箓’很神奇，但放在「神只店铺」中也最多两道神力。
他堂堂从九品的土地正神，缺这点神力吗？
想到这里。
他突然心念一动。
不能卖——
那是不是可以买？
作为穿越而来的蓝星神只，他可是拥有「区域交易」的。
任何蓝星神只都能将物品在「区域交易」中上架销售。
而现在——

是穿越过来的第二天，想来很多蓝星神只都已经完成了【个人任务——壹】，得到了任务奖励。
content_en:
"Is the martial arts cultivation improved?"
“I didn’t expect that the village chief’s martial arts aspirations were so strong.”
"It's a pity that his martial arts qualifications are not good enough. He is almost the same as Li Youming."
"At the age of thirty-five, I have only completed two qi and blood transformations. Once I reach the first-level median, I can no longer make any progress."
"I am fairly fair as a person. I have made small mistakes but not big ones."
"Small good deeds have been done, but no great deeds have been done."
"Since you have such a devout faith..."
"Your prayer will be fulfilled..."
Li Yue looked calm.
He has two first-level ‘blessing urns’ in his hand.
The first-level 'Blessing God' can promote a believer with no cultivation from a mortal to a first-level 'Physical Refining Realm' warrior.
Moreover, after being promoted, there will be two transformations of Qi and blood, and he will become a first-level intermediate 'Physical Refining Realm' warrior.
This is one of the effects.
And the first-level ‘blessing urn’ has another function.
It can allow a warrior who is already at the first-level body refining realm to improve his cultivation by two small realms, but cannot cross the big realm.
That is to say——
The original first-level lower level can be directly promoted to the first-level upper level!
The original first-order median can be raised to the first-order limit!
But even if it was originally a first-level high level, it can still only be promoted to the first-level limit!
"As for the other first-level 'Blessing God'..."
He glanced at the list of 'Class B Believers'.
At this time, the number of ‘Class B believers’ has increased to twenty-seven!
But most of them are old and middle-aged people.
There are only two young people.
One is 22-year-old Li Xiuwu.
One is 25-year-old Li Deming.
"Li Deming is Li Youming's second son."
"A family should not be overly gracious."
"Give this first-level 'Blessing Divine Urn' to Li Xiuwu."
he said to himself.
As for selling the first-order ‘Blessing Divine Urn’ in the ‘God Store’, he had no such idea at all.
For first-level items, even if the 'Blessing God' is very magical, it can only have two divine powers at most when placed in the 'God Shop'.
He is a dignified ninth-grade land righteous god. Does he lack this kind of divine power?
Think of this.
Suddenly he had a thought.
Can't sell——
Is that available for purchase?
As a blue star god who came from time to time, he has "regional trading".
Any Blue Star God can put items on the shelves for sale in "Regional Trading".
And now——
It's the second day after time travel. I think many Blue Star gods have completed [Personal Mission - One] and received mission rewards.
